scope: Original PLY-3 independent-array restore; owned process private-memory snapshots
method: Isolated server removed the numeric-array reuse callback and seeded ordinary destination arrays. At download, GUI import completion and post-reopen verification, the guarded harness launched a process-tree snapshot and summed private bytes by Chrome process type. The snapshot helper itself is included in the job and can influence the peak.
interpretation: The primary renderer process is the dominant observed growth between sampled download and import; Chrome browser private memory fell over the same interval and GPU private memory changed. This is a lead, not proof of the allocation source.
limitations: Snapshots are not simultaneous measurements and do not identify the peak allocation, distinguish individual renderer workers or prove causation.
This is one injected diagnostic run with sampling overhead; previous independent-copy runs exceeded 4 GiB.
No production code changed and no native acceptance is implied.
